description_en: Summarizes the actual benefits of clustering for the current tenant in the current region, including the number of benefited jobs, saved compute unit (CU) hours, and shuffle data volume. Retrieves the benefits for the last day or the cumulative benefits since clustering was applied
description_zh: 汇总当前租户在当前地域的聚簇实际收益，包括受益作业数、节省的 CU 时和 Shuffle 数据量。可查询最近一天或自应用聚簇以来的累计收益
name: GetAutoClusterUtility

parameters.help_en: The scope of benefit statistics. A value of false indicates that the daily benefits from the latest batch of data are retrieved. A value of true indicates that the cumulative benefits since clustering was applied are retrieved. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 收益统计范围。false 表示取最新一批数据中的当日收益，true 表示累计统计聚簇应用后的收益。默认为 false
parameters.name: since_created

data.description_en: The results of querying the actual benefits of automatic clustering for the tenant
data.description_zh: 查询租户的自动聚簇实际收益的结果

benefitJobCount.description_en: The number of jobs that benefited from automatic clustering
benefitJobCount.description_zh: 自动聚簇收益统计中受益的作业数量

savedCu.description_en: The amount of computing resources saved by automatic clustering, in compute unit (CU) hours

savedShuffle.description_en: The volume of shuffle data saved by automatic clustering, in GB
